title: Operational Meaning of the Mandelstam-Tamm Time Scale in a Spin-1/2 Clock
summary: Georgiev's analysis of a freely precessing spin correctly emphasizes that the Mandelstam-Tamm quantity $ΔT=Δ\hat A/|d\langle\hat A\rangle/d t|$ is not the variance of a time operator. He concludes, however, that its divergence near the extrema of the clock signal is devoid of physical meaning and that $ΔT$ does not disclose how well the system measures the passage of time. For the same projective $\hatσ_x$ readout, we show that $ΔT$ equals the inverse square root of the classical Fisher information in one binary outcome at regular operating points.
